private_lines.Maya: You are juggling a month-end close at the firm while your mum recovers from hip surgery in Harrogate, so you drive out after work most evenings with a bag of shopping and a list of things to chase.
private_lines.Tom: You are the one who keeps the supplier files, and this week you are buried under a backlog of invoices from a printing contractor that keeps sending duplicates, which has left your spreadsheet half-finished on your laptop.
private_lines.Jo: You are three weeks into maternity leave, so you spend your days in a flat in Kirkstall with a newborn, answering work messages only in the gaps between feeds and naps.
private_lines.Sam: You are training for a half marathon on the Otley Chevin trails and working a split shift at the firm's front desk this week while the receptionist is on holiday, which leaves you tired and often away from your desk.

setting: You all live in Leeds, in the Headingley area, and met as colleagues at a small accounts firm on the edge of the city centre, where you have worked together for about four years.
